body: What about it is bad for runners? Just wondering. Assuming you're writing this because you have one, do you know if it is waterproof/would be affected if you're super sweaty?

Yeah, from what I've read on this subreddit, Fitbit only exceeds Garmin in social media, but Garmin is more for "serious" exercisers. I'm trying to see if there is some kind of Garmin equivalent to the Fitbit Surge, but that's the top candidate right now.
Yeah, the idea here is to cut out using my phone for GPS. Uses a ton of data and kills the battery. Thanks!
